key.name: show-hud
key.description: Shows the native Spectre system and network cards on the desktop.

key.name: hud-compact
key.description: Uses a more compact desktop HUD layout.

key.name: app-grid-initialized
key.description: Records whether Spectre created a valid first-login GNOME application layout.

key.name: wallpaper-mode
key.description: spectre-auto pairs the Spectre light and dark defaults. custom preserves the user's selected wallpaper across appearance changes.

key.name: appearance-profile
key.description: Tracks the last applied Spectre shell appearance profile without overriding user wallpaper choices.

key.name: windows-shortcuts-initialized
key.description: Prevents Spectre updates from overwriting shortcuts after the first user configuration.
